title: Org Security Audit — August 2026
summary: Consolidated, adversarially verified security audit across five surfaces of the organization: the public-demo Studio backend, Quality Studio, the public websites, the runner host, and the chat/token-economy libraries. Eight candidate exploit findings entered adversarial refutation; seven survived as confirmed (one high, five medium, one low) and one was reclassified as verified-mitigated with no live exploit path. A prioritized remediation table plus appendices record what was checked and dismissed, including twenty-two low and informational observations from the single-surface deep audits. Decision-pending: the operator triages; no cards were created.
